name.ja: オーリック・フレイムキーパー

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a Masterflame rune roll by rolling a dice.

effect.en:
On a 1, or if the roll is equal to or less than the number of friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units that have been destroyed during the battle, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Grimnir’s Grit:*** The target has **WARD (5+)**.

***Grimnir’s Resolve:*** You can re-roll charge rolls for the target.

***Grimnir’s Vengeance:*** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
Subtract 2 from Masterflame rune rolls for this unit while it has any **grudge marks**.
If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, give each visible friendly **GRIMMDRON** unit within 6" of it 1 **grudge mark**.

effect.en: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks while it has any **grudge marks**.

name.ja: オーリック・ルーンファーザー

declare.en: Pick a friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the **royal retinue**.

effect.en:
For the rest of the battle, while the **royal retinue** is wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for the **royal retinue’s** attacks.
• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
While this unit has any **grudge marks**, the **royal retinue** has **WARD (4+)** while it is wholly within 6" of this unit.

effect.en: Add 1 to charge rolls for visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. While this unit has any **grudge marks**, add 2 to charge rolls for visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit instead.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit or a non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit within 3" of this unit

effect.en:
If you declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit, pick a friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, is within this unit’s combat range and is visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

If you declared a **FIGHT** ability for a friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit, if this unit has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by the friendly non-**HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability lets another friendly unit fight immediately after this unit or lets this unit fight immediately after that other friendly unit. Add 1 to hit rolls for whichever of those two units fights after the first.*

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit to be this unit’s quarry. You can pick a unit that has been deployed in reserve.

effect.ja:
獲物を対象としたのユニットの攻撃は、ヒットロールおよびウーンズロールに+1の修正を受ける。
このユニットが、自身の獲物と近接戦闘中であるときに全滅した場合、このユニットを全滅させたアビリティが解決された直後に、このユニットの獲物の12mv以内に一部でも入っている各味方**グリムドロン**・ユニットは、それぞれ**宿怨マーク**を1個獲得する。
effect.en:
Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks that target its quarry.

If this unit is destroyed while it is in combat with its quarry, give 1 **grudge mark** to each friendly **GRIMMDRON** unit within 12" of this unit’s quarry immediately after the ability that destroyed this unit has been resolved.

effect.en:
Your opponent can pick whether the target will **attempt to sidestep** or not. If they do, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

Then, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target **attempted to sidestep**. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

keywords: カザライト・ホールド

name.ja: ゴトレック・グルニソン

effect.en: This unit cannot have **grudge marks** and cannot be affected by **ANCESTRAL VOW** abilities.

The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

While this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES** or **MONSTERS**:

• It can only pick those enemy units to be the targets of its combat attacks.

• Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** unit in combat with it.

**Designer’s Note**: *A unit with both the* **HERO** *and* **MONSTER** *keywords only adds 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.*

name.ja: 至高王ヴァランクロム

effect.en: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Karak War Council’s Armoury** is 4.

declare.en: Pick another visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. For each **grudge mark** this unit has, you can pick another eligible unit to be an additional target.

effect.en:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to the targets while they are wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 3" to this range for each **grudge mark** this unit has.

• The target’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
• If the target has no **grudge marks**, it counts as having 1 **grudge mark**.

Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Stonesmith’s Disruption**: The stonesmith causes the ground under a group of enemies to tremble violently, disrupting their cohesion.*

Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target has a maximum control score of 1.

***Grudgebearer’s Denunciation***: *The exhortations of the grudgebearer instil in the duardin a relentless drive to enact vengeance on the foe.*

While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, visible friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those friendly units by **RETREAT** abilities.

***Holdseeker’s Guidance***: *The holdseeker reveals magically resonant areas of the battlefield to aid the efforts of those working the runes.*

Add 1 to casting rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this battle to be the target.

effect.en:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will **accept the accusation** or **reject the accusation**.

If they **accept the accusation**, for the rest of the battle round, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units that target that enemy unit.

If they **reject the accusation**, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the battle round.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase

effect.en: This unit can move D6" or, if it is your movement phase, it can move 2D6". It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the target and roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

keywords: カザライト・ホールド

name.ja: ヒュルダ・ドラックブラッド

timing.en: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round

declare.en: You must use this ability. Pick an enemy unit to be **grudged**. You can pick an enemy unit in reserve.

effect.en:
For the rest of the battle:

• While the **grudged** enemy unit is within 12" of and visible to this unit, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

• While there is no **grudged** enemy unit on the battlefield, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **KHAZALITE HOLDS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
While this unit is in combat, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly non-**HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY** units while they are within 3" of and visible to this unit.

declare.en: Pick this unit and up to 2 other visible friendly non-**HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

effect.en: If this unit has any **grudge marks**, apply this effect automatically. Otherwise, roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to that target in each phase.

effect.en: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If this unit has any **grudge marks**, add 1 to the roll. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
fix: メレーアタックよって撃破
メレーアタックによって撃破

note: 日本語版「メレーアタックよって」は「に」の脱字（バトルトーム・サプリメント カザライト・ホールド 2026年11月 p.4）。

keywords: カザライト・ホールド
units.notes_en: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

name.ja: ヴァルカイト・バーザーカー（焔鋼の武器装備）

effect.ja: このユニットが1個以上の**宿怨マーク**を持つ間、このユニットは近接武器の【攻撃回数】に+1の修正を受ける。
effect.en: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit has any **grudge marks**.

keywords: カザライト・ホールド

name.ja: ヴルキン・フレイムシーカー

effect.en:
While this unit has any **grudge marks**:
• Subtract 2 from the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** melee weapons used by enemy **MONSTERS** while they are in combat with this unit.

• Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s **COMPANION** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

keywords: カザライト・ホールド

wargear.en:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Vulkyn Weapons.***

• ***1/9 models is a Kyndledroth and must replace their weapons with Kyndledroth’s Fangs.***
• ***The champion is a Vulkyn Runefather and cannot replace their weapons.***

name.ja: ザールグロンの焔吐き

effect.ja: この**顕現**を召喚したユニットが1個以上の**宿怨マーク**を持つ場合、この**顕現**のレンジアタックはヒットロールに+1の修正を受ける。
effect.en: Add 1 to hit rolls for this **MANIFESTATION’S** shooting attacks while the unit that summoned this **MANIFESTATION** has any **grudge marks**.
